name: Altena (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Altena (a queen with sword and chequy field on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Altena; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Altena arms — queen with sword over chequy
